rationale: Reproduction question rather than new ground: the main finding currently rests on six receipts, and the one that carried the quorum-scale consequence (queued read states aside) is acc6241dce584bc0a6817149dbe19f98-experiment, whose receipt 4ff9bf25cb164dd8bcf9d3be02aa1568 first showed the window closing on the next heartbeat and a single forged delivery carrying an up-to-date candidate to leadership at term 3. That experiment was itself a revision of the original harness, and it has not been executed a second time in its fixed form. Repeating it from its retained inputs in a clean copy asks whether the observation is schedule-stable rather than a favourable interleaving of one run, which is exactly what a repeat can establish and what a fresh scenario cannot. No new scenario, no record change beyond the receipt this produces.
